title: Anduril hero
description: A film that fills 96% of the window under a 72px black band: edge to edge on phones, inset by the page gutter with 2px corners on desktop. No headline; an optional all-caps caption appears over the film every 12 seconds, decoding letter by letter, then fades away.
notes: pass the film (or an image) as media; empty shows a placeholder surface
leaves 72px at the top for the fixed anduril-header (underHeader={false} to drop it)
needs JavaScript (hydrate: load) only for the caption decode; the caption loop itself is CSS
